mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rid}, NOW())
INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id, created_at) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{pid}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT permission_id FROM sys_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permission WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
